entries.title: Isaiah 62:1
segments: ¶For Zion's sake I will not hold My peace, And for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, Until her righteousness goes forth as brightness, And her salvation as a lamp [that] burns.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:2
segments: The Gentiles shall see your righteousness, And all kings your glory. You shall be called by a new name, Which the mouth of the LORD will name.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:3
segments: You shall also be a crown of glory In the hand of the LORD, And a royal diadem In the hand of your God.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:4
segments: You shall no longer be termed Forsaken, Nor shall your land any more be termed Desolate; But you shall be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; For the LORD delights in you, And your land shall be married.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:5
segments: For [as] a young man marries a virgin, [So] shall your sons marry you; And [as] the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, [So] shall your God rejoice over you.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:6
segments: ¶I have set watchmen on your walls, O Jerusalem; They shall never hold their peace day or night. You who make mention of the LORD, do not keep silent,

entries.title: Isaiah 62:7
segments: And give Him no rest till He establishes And till He makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:8
segments: The LORD has sworn by His right hand And by the arm of His strength: "Surely I will no longer give your grain [As] food for your enemies; And the sons of the foreigner shall not drink your new wine, For which you have labored.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:9
segments: But those who have gathered it shall eat it, And praise the LORD; Those who have brought it together shall drink it in My holy courts."

entries.title: Isaiah 62:10
segments: ¶Go through, Go through the gates! Prepare the way for the people; Build up, Build up the highway! Take out the stones, Lift up a banner for the peoples!

entries.title: Isaiah 62:11
segments: Indeed the LORD has proclaimed To the end of the world: "Say to the daughter of Zion, 'Surely your salvation is coming; Behold, His reward [is] with Him, And His work before Him.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 62:12
segments: And they shall call them The Holy People, The Redeemed of the LORD; And you shall be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
